subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A news company used AI to draft simple reports about weather, sports scores, and market changes.”?
options: The editor caught the mistake before publication.
When the mistake was discovered, everyone laughed.
The newspaper became better because of the mistake.
The math teacher used the mistake as a lesson.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The editor caught the mistake before publication.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「When the mistake was discovered, everyone laughed.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The newspaper became better because of the mistake.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The math teacher used the mistake as a lesson.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The editor caught the mistake before publication.」，答案為「The editor caught the mistake before publication.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The editor caught the mistake before publication.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
